chapter.title: Errors
chapter.para: These requirements say what happens when a guest or the hypervisor itself goes wrong.

section.title: SRQ_HV_ERR_001
section.para: The hypervisor shall stop a VM, and only that VM, and report the reason with the registers of its vCPU, when its guest accesses memory outside its RAM, and also: on x86_64 when it takes a triple fault, halts with interrupts disabled, uses string I/O, has an invalid state or makes an exit that the hypervisor does not expect; on arm64 when it takes a system error, runs 32-bit code, makes an exception that the hypervisor does not expect, or accesses a device with an instruction that cannot be decoded.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: A fault of one guest must not disturb the others.

section.title: SRQ_HV_ERR_002
section.para: The hypervisor shall let the other VMs go on running when a VM stops.

section.title: SRQ_HV_ERR_003
section.para: The hypervisor shall report a fatal error of its own on its console, with the number of its CPU, and halt that CPU.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The hypervisor cannot recover from a fault of its own.

section.title: SRQ_HV_ERR_004
section.para: The hypervisor shall stop, with a message that gives the option of QEMU that creates it, if a serial port that the configuration needs does not exist on the computer (arm64).

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The configuration names the ports of a computer that the hypervisor does not have.
